title.value: A systematic analysis of ICSD-3 diagnostic criteria and proposal for further structured iteration
title.justification: This is the title mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: A systematic analysis of ICSD-3 diagnostic criteria and proposal for further structured iteration

analysis.description: The paper systematically analyzes the International Classification of Sleep Disorders-3 (ICSD-3) diagnostic criteria by labeling and structuring them using an iterative process. It also discusses the organization of these criteria with respect to their reliability and validity for diagnosing sleep disorders.

type.justification: The paper is focused on a theoretical analysis of diagnostic criteria rather than conducting empirical experiments.
type.quote: The main objective of this theoretical review is to systematically analyze the type of International Classification of Sleep Disorders-3 (ICSD-3) diagnostic criteria...
